Subject: Breakpoint anchoring sensitivity analysis for AtlasAI per-token ladder

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the AtlasAI team had great questions about inference latency at scale. Procurement asked for an updated pricing sketch so their finance team can model forecasts. Two quick asks from our side to make the proposal useful: 

- Can you share a 12-week token forecast (attached is what you already sent for Q3 — thanks).
- Are you more constrained by budgeting predictability (team prefers blended effective rate) or by minimizing marginal cost as you scale (engineering prefers marginal tiers)?

We typically negotiate two approaches for hosted API customers: a marginal-breakpoint ladder (pay marginal price per breakpoint) or a blended effective-rate ladder (monthly effective rate applied to total usage). Both have trade-offs for predictability vs unit economics. If you can confirm which preference wins, we can run a sensitivity analysis showing effective monthly unit cost across realistic breakpoints.

I attached AtlasAI_usage_forecast_Q3.xlsx for reference — if there's an updated sheet, send it over. If it helps, we can run three anchored breakpoint sets and show effective rate curves for each. Would you be available for a 30-min call Wed or Thu?

Thanks,

My thinking for a compromise (feel free to push back): cap a blended effective rate for the first two breakpoints (gives procurement predictability for initial ramp) and switch to marginal pricing beyond the third breakpoint (gives unit economics as they scale). Agree with Rishi's scope. Quick summary from running the model against the updated forecast:

- Recommended anchored breakpoints (tokens/month): 500M, 1.5B, 3B.
- Example pricing (illustrative): marginal prices [$0.00060, $0.00045, $0.00030, $0.00020] per token across the four bands; blended effective rates for those bands yield monthly effective $/1K tokens of roughly [$0.52, $0.38, $0.29] under the forecast.
- Cliffs: largest step is between 500M -> 1.5B (effective rate delta ~30% on the ramp months).

Proposed compromise: 1) Offer a capped blended effective rate for the first two bands (months 0-3) with a true-up at day 91; 2) convert to marginal billing for months beyond breakpoint 3; 3) include an explanatory table for FP&A that shows smoothing examples (we can pull this into the one-pager).

Marissa: legal notes — keep the true-up language limited to accounting adjustments (no retroactive credits beyond the 90-day window) and add an escape if AtlasAI's production pattern changes >2x vs forecast in a rolling 30-day window. Will draft suggested clause.

Dev: attaching the sensitivity charts you asked for in the model (see attached PDF). If you want different anchoring sets, say which multiples you prefer and I can rerun.

Laura Bennett

Subject: Re: Breakpoint anchoring sensitivity analysis for AtlasAI per-token ladder — proposed compromise

Priya / Atlas procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on our analysis, here's the proposed structure for the hosted API per-token ladder (summary):

- Anchored breakpoints (tokens/month): 500M | 1.5B | 3B
- Billing approach: blended effective rate capped for first two bands (months 0–3) with a 90-day lookback true-up; marginal pricing beyond the third breakpoint.
- Protective clause: escape if actual production >2x forecast in any rolling 30-day window; no retroactive credits outside the 90-day true-up.
- Example: Under Atlas's forecast, estimated effective $/1K tokens in month 1 = $0.50 (capped blended), month 4 (post-true-up) = $0.36 (marginal mix). Full table attached.

Next steps:
1) If procurement is ok, we can convert this to a short addendum (2 paragraphs + table) to the MSA and share redlines.
2) If Atlas wants more smoothing we can add a seasonal smoothing band (60-day smoothing) but that will slightly raise the blended cap.

Priya — want to take Thu 10:00 PT to walk through the one-pager and table? If procurement prefers, we can also send the draft addendum and let legal review asynchronously.

Cheers,
Rishi
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0110
